about: Scoring fixture for the evidence coach. Each case is one student response to one real task. 'expect' is what a reading teacher would want: accept (positive feedback is deserved) or withhold (it is not). 'knownLimit' marks cases the rule-based coach is known to get wrong; they are reported and do not fail the run. Written by the founder's side for development; replace and extend with real pilot responses, and have a second educator score a sample before treating these labels as ground truth.
